gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i1: Verifies that {@link LocalDate#until(java.time.chrono.ChronoLocalDate)} returns a zero period when the target accounting date denotes the very same day on the t
ADDED i2: Accounting calendar whose year ends on the Sunday nearest the end of August, divided into thirteen even four-week months, with the leap week placed in month 13.
ADDED i3: Each row pairs an accounting date with the ISO date that falls on the same calendar day.
